_note: THE PROMISE REGISTER. Seeded ONCE, by hand, from the eighteen forward events in timeline/data/timeline.json as they stood on the day this register opened, and APPEND-ONLY from that moment. Every row is stamped first_published with the opening date and first_published_basis 'register opened', because this repository's history begins 2026-08-18 and only two of its commits touch timeline.json, so no build step can reconstruct what was published before this file existed. When a date moves, the new date goes in current_date AND a dated entry is appended to history[]; nothing is overwritten and no row is deleted. The register cannot report what happened before it existed, and the page says so.
_rule: Only a date already published is eligible for this register, so publishing a date can never be worse than withholding one.
source_of_rows: timeline/data/timeline.json, events where delivered == false, as of 2026-08-13

calibration.statistic: the share of dated public commitments that resolved on the date first published
calibration.floor_basis: spec default, Open Question 4 unanswered: below six resolved commitments the page prints the count and no rate

unsourced_goal.counted_in_rows_reason: A row with no source document does not meet this register’s entry test (a date, an owner and a source document), so it is shown beside the register and excluded from every count on this page. Open Question 1 decides whether it becomes a row.
